256.caption: A textured grey concrete wall, segmented by faint vertical lines, shows subtle pores and small dark spots, with a dark overhead structure entering the top right.
Overhead, steel trusses with corrugated metal roofing and embedded fluorescent lights frame a diagonal view, casting sharp shadows on the textured concrete wall.
Overhead, parallel fluorescent lights run along dark steel trusses, their rectangular shapes and cool glow contrasting with the corrugated metal roof's textured, grey surface.
A teal handrail, mounted on a textured concrete wall, curves horizontally, its metallic sheen contrasting with the rough, grey surface as light casts sharp shadows.
A long, angled concrete wall with a teal handrail runs diagonally, its textured surface and sharp geometry defined by slanted morning light casting distinct shadows.
A red ticket kiosk stands alone on a grey platform, framed by angular concrete walls and overhead steel trusses, with a thin teal handrail receding into the distance.
Dark grey concrete pavement, textured with subtle pores and faint seams, meets a light grey wall at a sharp angle, under slanted morning light.
Grey concrete pavement, textured with fine pores and faint seams, stretches diagonally, bordered by a light wall's shadow and a teal handrail's edge.
Gray concrete pavement with subtle texture and faint seams, bathed in slanted morning light casting long, soft shadows across its surface.
